Dir.condition: bType_Dir set, weakDir=false; no mixed-order automatic override

Traction.condition: bType_trac + bType_gen + bType_flat; explicit early weakDir=false return

Neu.condition: bType_Neu + bType_bfs; pressure scalar prescribed, not a pressure-field inverse

Weak.condition: Dir AND fluid/FSI AND explicit Weakly_applied=true; absent from target XML
